digest.en: Russia's military losses in Ukraine are estimated to exceed 350,000 soldiers, according to a new report. Meanwhile, tensions between the US and Iran continue to escalate, with Washington striking two Iranian-flagged tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Labour's loss of power in Wales marks a significant shift in UK politics.
digest.hi: भारत और अमेरिका एआई पर सहयोग बढ़ाने की तैयारी कर रहे हैं, जिससे चीन को घेरने की रणनीति के तहत यह कदम उठाया जा रहा है। इस बीच, इस्राइल और लेबनान के बीच 14-15 मई को अगले दौर की बातचीत होगी, जिसकी जानकारी अमेरिकी विदेश विभाग ने दी है।

articles.title: Russia Has Lost More Than 350,000 Soldiers, New Estimate Finds
articles.summary: Russia has lost over 350,000 soldiers. The total death toll on both sides may be around half a million. The number raises the prospect that about half a million soldiers in total have died on the Russian and Ukrainian sides.

articles.title: Hungary's new PM to be sworn in during 'regime change' party
articles.summary: Péter Magyar will be sworn in as Hungary's new PM after his Tisza party won a landslide victory. Nearly a month ago Péter Magyar steered his Tisza party to a landslide victory, sweeping away 16 years of rule by Viktor Orbán.

articles.summary: Iran is reviewing a U. S. proposal at its own pace, according to a report. U. S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had indicated Washington expected a response from Iran, but no timeline has been set for a decision.
